title: Canonical section projection arrow
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, let $r:V\to X$ and $i:X\to V$ be scheme morphisms with $i\gg r=1_X$, and let $M$ belong to the unbounded derived category of internal $\Lambda_X$-modules. Use the actual derived functors, relative tensors, canonical projection mate $\pi$ and pullback section comparison $l_M:Li^*Lr^*M\cong M$ of [def-sfb-module-projection-section-arrows]. Write $U=\Lambda_X$ for the derived tensor unit. Define the canonical section arrow
$$a_M:Lr^*M\otimes^{\mathbf L}Ri_*U\xrightarrow{\pi_{i,Lr^*M,U}}Ri_*(Li^*Lr^*M\otimes^{\mathbf L}U)\xrightarrow{Ri_*(l_M\otimes1)}Ri_*(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}U)\xrightarrow{Ri_*(\rho_M)}Ri_*M.$$
It is the specified projection map followed by the canonical section and right-unit identifications, with no new comparison chosen.
